tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. Omit cart_token to start a new cart — the response's cart_token must be carried into every later cart, delivery, and checkout call. The price is re-validated live at this moment and again at checkout; if it changed, checkout reports prices_changed instead of placi

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Place the order for the cart identified by cart_token. Call ONLY after the customer has explicitly confirmed the purchase and given their name plus phone or email. There is no online payment step: the order is registered as a lead and the store confirms it with the customer by phone/email (delivery

tools.name: estimate_delivery
tools.description: Estimate shipping prices and delivery timeframes for the current cart in a destination city_id (use search_cities first for non-Moscow cities). Optionally pass pickup_point_id + pickup_point_carrier_id from search_pickup_points to price a specific pickup point. Returns courier, pickup-point, and car

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Current cart contents with live prices, line totals and the grand total. Empty cart returns empty items and zero totals (not an error).

tools.name: get_checkout_url
tools.description: Produce a one-time link (valid 5 minutes) that opens the live Tachka.ru checkout in a browser with this cart pre-loaded and the city pre-selected. Use it to hand the purchase to a human instead of placing the order yourself; checkout on the site re-validates live prices.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full details for one product_id returned by search_products: brand, SKU, price, stock, exact delivery and pickup dates for city_id, attributes, description (plain text) and image URLs.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Look up a delivery city_id by name across Russia and the CIS (Kazakhstan, Belarus, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan). Call this first whenever the customer is outside Moscow (default city_id is 414 = Moscow). Pass the returned city_id into search_products, get_product_details, cart tools, estimate_delivery, sear

tools.name: search_pickup_points
tools.description: List and filter carrier pickup points (CDEK, Yandex, KIT, Energia, etc.) available in a destination city_id (use search_cities first). Pass the chosen pickup_point_id, pickup_point_carrier_id and address into estimate_delivery or checkout.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Tachka.ru auto-parts catalog. Accepts a part name, an OEM/article number, a 17-character VIN, or a car + part combination (e.g. "тормозные колодки киа рио 3", "P24061", "коврики BMW X5 G05"). The catalog is in Russian; Russian queries give the best results. Supports optional in_stock_only

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set a product's quantity in the cart. quantity 0 removes the item. Returns the full cart snapshot, same as add_to_cart.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_url, get_product_details · Public sink: checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_url, get_product_details · Public sink: checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
